description: This Java enum defines various parameter types for loan products within the Fineract project. It contains constants representing different loan parameter types, methods to retrieve associated values and codes, and utility methods to identify parameter types based on integer input.

classes.name: LoanProductParamType
classes.description: Enumeration of various loan product parameter types including INVALID, PRINCIPAL, INTEREST RATE, and REPAYMENT, with utility methods for parameter identification and type checking.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the parameter type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the parameter type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding LoanProductParamType enum value, defaults to INVALID for unrecognized input.

methods.name: isParamTypePrincipal
methods.description: Checks if the parameter type is PRINCIPAL.

methods.name: isParamTypeInterestTate
methods.description: Checks if the parameter type is INTERESTRATE (note: there's a typo 'Tate' instead of 'Rate')

methods.name: isParamTypeRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the parameter type is REPAYMENT.
